Yeah, okay. And Al Vizzutti, Pugh Birch (Johnson--ed.) Pezuti, among others, like Jim Pew and Urch and so forth, you've attracted people from Eastman School of Music, excellent classical training and can sit in any kind of chair, anywhere. And you've got those people in your band, or have had them in your band.
